enum EntryStep
  case SetProp(prop: u16, value: i64, tolerant: bool)
  case SetPropRuntime(prop: u16, slot: String, if_missing: FfiMissingRuntimeValue, tolerant: bool)
  case GetProp(prop: u16, captures: Vec<CaptureInfo>, tolerant: bool)
  case ReadEcho(prop: u16, captures: Vec<CaptureInfo>, tolerant: bool)
  case SendOp(op: u16, params: Vec<EntryParam>, captures: Vec<CaptureInfo>, repeat: u32, tolerant: bool)
  case OpenChannel(role: SocketRole, tolerant: bool)
  case ReopenSession(tolerant: bool)
  case CloseSession(transport_close: bool, tolerant: bool)
  case AwaitUntil(source: FfiAwaitSource, until: FfiPredicate, on_each: Vec<EntryStep>, captures: Vec<CaptureInfo>, timeout_ms: u32, interval_ms: u32, tolerant: bool)
  case Retry(steps: Vec<EntryStep>, fallback_steps: Vec<EntryStep>, when_response_codes: Vec<u16>, when_failure_classes: Vec<FfiRetryFailureClass>, max_attempts: u32, retry_delay_ms: u32, tolerant: bool)
  case Loop(kind: FfiLoopKind, tolerant: bool)
  case If(slot: String, equals: u64, then_steps: Vec<EntryStep>, tolerant: bool)
  case IfElse(slot: String, equals: u64, then_steps: Vec<EntryStep>, else_steps: Vec<EntryStep>, tolerant: bool)

enum Step
  case BleConnect(opts: StepOptions)
  case BleAwaitDisconnect(timeout_ms: u32, opts: StepOptions)
  case BleRequestMtu(requested_mtu: u16, minimum_mtu: Option<u16>, opts: StepOptions)
  case BleDiscoverServices(opts: StepOptions)
  case BleWrite(gatt: String, value: StepValue, notification_fence: Option<String>, opts: StepOptions)
  case BleRead(gatt: String, encoding: String, capture_as: String, transform: Vec<Transform>, opts: StepOptions)
  case BlePeripheralName(capture_as: String, opts: StepOptions)
  case BleSubscribe(gatt: String, timeout_ms: u32, mode: CccdMode, opts: StepOptions)
  case BleNotify(gatt: String, until: BleNotifyUntil, capture_as: Option<String>, capture: Vec<NotifyCapture>, mode: CccdMode, timeout_ms: u32, opts: StepOptions)
  case BleAwaitUntil(source: AwaitSource, capture: Vec<NotifyCapture>, capture_as: Option<String>, until: Predicate, fail_when: Option<Predicate>, failure_evidence: Option<BleAwaitFailureEvidence>, on_each: Vec<Step>, timeout_ms: u32, interval_ms: u32, opts: StepOptions)
  case BleWriteChunk(source: String, index: String, size: u32, gatt: String, frame: Vec<ChunkFrameField>, sentinel_index: u32, checksum: Option<ChunkChecksum>, opts: StepOptions)
  case Acquire(name: String, from: Vec<Step>, opts: StepOptions)
  case AcquireFirmware(from: AcquireSource, opts: StepOptions)
  case If(condition: Predicate, then_branch: Vec<Step>, else_branch: Vec<Step>, tolerant: bool)
  case Retry(steps: Vec<Step>, when_failure: ExecutorStepFailureKind, on_failure: Vec<Step>, retry_when: Predicate, max_attempts: u32, retry_delay_ms: u32, failure_context: Vec<String>)
  case BleDelay(duration_ms: u32, opts: StepOptions)
  case NikonLssAuthenticate(gatt: String, client_device_id: StepValue, nonce: StepValue, timeout_ms: u32, opts: StepOptions)
  case NikonLssReadConnectionConfiguration(gatt: String, flags_capture_as: String, ssid_capture_as: String, password_capture_as: String, security_mode_capture_as: String, spp_max_length_capture_as: Option<String>, opts: StepOptions)
  case UsbClaim(class: u8, subclass: u8, protocol: u8, opts: StepOptions)
  case UsbBulkOut(data: StepValue, opts: StepOptions)
  case UsbBulkIn(max_length: u32, encoding: String, capture_as: String, transform: Vec<Transform>, opts: StepOptions)
  case UsbAwaitInterrupt(encoding: String, capture_as: String, transform: Vec<Transform>, timeout_ms: Option<u32>, opts: StepOptions)

object BleExecutorTransport callback_trait
  method await_disconnect() async throws(TransportError)
  method connect() async throws(TransportError)
  method ensure_services_discovered() async throws(TransportError)
  method next_notification(characteristic: String) async throws(TransportError) -> Bytes
  method peripheral_name() async throws(TransportError) -> String
  method read(characteristic: String) async throws(TransportError) -> Bytes
  method request_mtu(mtu: u16) async throws(TransportError) -> u16
  method sleep(ms: u32) async throws(TransportError)
  method subscribe(characteristic: String, mode: CccdMode) async throws(TransportError)
  method write(characteristic: String, value: Bytes) async throws(TransportError)
  method write_with_notification_fence(characteristic: String, value: Bytes, notification_characteristic: String) async throws(TransportError)

object ConfigStore
  constructor from_bundle(body_yaml: String, manufacturer_yaml: Option<String>) throws(ConfigError)
  constructor from_manufacturer_index(index_yaml: String, model_bodies: Vec<KeyValue>) throws(ConfigError)
  constructor from_manufacturer_index_with_defaults(index_yaml: String, manufacturer_yaml: String, model_bodies: Vec<KeyValue>) throws(ConfigError)
  constructor from_tiers(body_yaml: String, manufacturer_yaml: Option<String>, fw_overlays: Vec<String>) throws(ConfigError)
  method action(connection: String, verb: ActionVerb) -> Option<Action>
  method action_catalog() -> ActionCatalog
  method ble_action(model: String, action: String) -> Option<BleActionPlan>
  method build_pcss_callback_ack(connection: String) throws(CodecError) -> Bytes
  method build_pcss_discovery(connection: String, callback_ipv4: String) throws(CodecError) -> Bytes
  method build_pcss_init(connection: String, initiator_guid: Bytes, client_ipv4: String, friendly_name: String) throws(CodecError) -> Bytes
  method camera_identity() -> CameraIdentityInfo
  method camera_initiated_transfer(model: String) -> Option<CameraInitiatedTransferInfo>
  method capabilities(_connection: String, mode: String) -> Vec<String>
  method confirm_device_info(model: String, device_info: PtpDeviceInfo) -> bool
  method connection_establishment(connection: String) -> Option<ConnectionEstablishmentInfo>
  method connection_expected_responder_guid(connection: String) -> Option<Bytes>
  method connection_init(connection: String) -> Option<InitShapeInfo>
  method connection_init_identity_with_runtime(connection: String, runtime_scope: Vec<KeyValue>) -> Option<ResolvedInitIdentityInfo>
  method connection_init_retry_policy(connection: String) -> Option<InitRetryPolicyInfo>
  method connection_init_with_runtime(connection: String, runtime_scope: Vec<KeyValue>) -> Option<InitShapeInfo>
  method connection_transition(from_connection: String, target_connection: String, target_mode: Option<String>) -> Option<ConnectionEstablishmentInfo>
  method connections(platform: Platform) -> Vec<ConnectionInfo>
  method control_for(connection: String, mode: String, prop: u16) -> Option<ControlInfo>
  method control_surface(connection: String, mode: String) -> Vec<ControlSurfaceInfo>
  method decode_property(prop: u16, raw: i64) -> Option<PropertyValueInfo>
  method detect_mode(_connection: String, observed: Vec<PropObservation>) -> Option<String>
  method encode_property(prop: u16, label: String) throws(CodecError) -> Bytes
  method encode_property_text(prop: u16, value: String) throws(CodecError) -> Bytes
  method encode_structured_integer_property(prop: u16, values: Vec<i64>) throws(CodecError) -> Bytes
  method establishment(model: String, connection: String, initial_scope: Vec<KeyValue>) -> Option<EstablishmentPlan>
  method fixed_value(key: String) -> Option<String>
  method focus_grid() -> Option<FocusGridInfo>
  method is_fallback_model(model: String) -> Option<bool>
  method media_format(code: u16) -> Option<MediaFormatInfo>
  method mode_entry(connection: String, from: Option<String>, to: String) -> Option<ModeEntryPlan>
  method model_store(model_id: String) -> Option<ConfigStore>
  method modes(connection: String) -> Vec<ModeInfo>
  method object_info_size_sentinel() -> Option<u64>
  method object_transfer_contract(connection: String) -> Option<ObjectTransferContractInfo>
  method operation_available(connection: String, mode: String, op: u16, observed: Vec<PropObservation>) -> Availability
  method operation_available_explained(connection: String, mode: String, op: u16, observed: Vec<PropObservation>) -> GateExplanation
  method operations() -> Vec<OperationInfo>
  method parse_pcss_notify(connection: String, payload: Bytes) throws(CodecError) -> PcssNotifyInfo
  method pcss_rendezvous(connection: String) -> Option<PcssRendezvousInfo>
  method port_for_role(connection: String, role: SocketRole) -> Option<u16>
  method properties() -> Vec<PropertyInfo>
  method property_payload(prop: u16) -> Option<PayloadInfo>
  method property_value_width(prop: u16) -> Option<ValueWidth>
  method recognize(observation: ScanObservation) -> Recognition
  method recognize_ready_for_reconnect(observation: ScanObservation, persisted_scope: Vec<KeyValue>) -> ReadyReconnectRecognition
  method reconnect_decision(model: String, observation: ScanObservation, persisted_scope: Vec<KeyValue>) -> ReconnectDecision
  method reconnect_policy(model: String) -> Option<ReconnectPolicy>
  method refine_establishment(plan_handle: String, firmware: String, scope: Vec<KeyValue>, next_step_index: u32) throws(EstablishmentError) -> EstablishmentRefinement
  method resolve_action_invocation(request: ActionInvocationRequest) throws(ActionResolutionError) -> ResolvedActionInvocation
  method selected_object_transfer(connection: String) throws(ConfigError) -> Option<SelectedObjectTransferInfo>
  method socket_bindings(connection: String) -> Vec<SocketBindingInfo>
  method transport_close(connection: String) throws(TransportCloseError) -> Option<TransportCloseInfo>
  method value(key: String) -> Option<ResolvedValue>
  method value_label(prop: u16, value: i64) -> Option<String>

  method on_activity(event: ConnectionActivityEvent)

object PcssExecutorTransport callback_trait
  method bind_callback_listener(port: u16) async throws(TransportError)
  method close_callback_connection() async throws(TransportError)
  method close_command_connection() async throws(TransportError)
  method connect_command(camera_ipv4: String, port: u16) async throws(TransportError)
  method next_callback() async throws(TransportError) -> PcssCallback
  method next_command_frame() async throws(TransportError) -> Bytes
  method send_callback_reply(payload: Bytes) async throws(TransportError)
  method send_command_frame(frame: Bytes) async throws(TransportError)
  method send_discovery(destination_ipv4: String, destination_port: u16, payload: Bytes) async throws(TransportError)
  method sleep(ms: u32) async throws(TransportError)

object PtpExecutorTransport callback_trait

  method next_command_frame() async throws(PtpTransportError) -> Bytes
  method next_event_frame(event_code: u16) async throws(PtpTransportError) -> Bytes
  method open_channel(role: SocketRole) async throws(PtpTransportError)
  method reopen_command_session() async throws(PtpTransportError) -> PtpSessionOpenResult
  method reserve_transaction_id() async throws(PtpTransportError) -> u32
  method send_command_frame(frame: Bytes) async throws(PtpTransportError)
  method sleep(ms: u32) async throws(PtpTransportError)

object PtpTransactionTransport callback_trait

  method shutdown() async throws(PtpTransactionError)
  method sleep(ms: u32) async throws(PtpTransactionError)
